en: Hand‑tinted postcard depicting a cylindrical medieval stone tower on a small hill, with crenellations and a conical roof fragment at the top. In the foreground a large flock of sheep grazes on a grassy slope, with a seated shepherd in traditional rural clothing at the lower left. The sky is a flat gradient of pale yellow to blue. At the top left of the image there is printed red text in German.
